findings.text: follow-on: _row_to_member rebuilds each member as a seven-key dict literal that does not carry has_dd_source, so it strips the flag the node added to _PATTERN_FAMILY_MEMBERS_QUERY before the rows reach select_anchor; assemble_family (harmonize.py:194, reached from imas_codex/cli/sn.py:3956) calls it on both branches, and member_has_dd_source's absence default (families.py:514 returns True) then re-admits the unsourced member, so the guard fails open on the CLI docs-family path. This is outside the node's declared write paths, so it is not a defect in the landed change; but the fragment at ssog-anchor-needs-dd-source.html:'ssog-anchor-needs-dd-source-flag-default' states the default is reachable 'only from harmonize.py, whose parent-grouping rows are assembled inline', which is too narrow - the pattern branch also loses the flag through this function, and that branch is why the _PATTERN_FAMILY_MEMBERS_QUERY projection was added.

justifications.durability: Seven assertions were added and each reddens under its own guard's removal - reinstating select_anchor's old body reddens four of them (negative-control.log: 4 failed, 3 passed, EXIT=1, including test_heuristic_skips_a_derived_parent_ranked_first), and reverting _eligible_anchor_candidate's test reddens test_jev_candidates_exclude_a_member_without_a_dd_source (tests/standard_names/test_anchor_needs_dd_source.py:130), which the single declared mutation did not exercise because it touched only select_anchor.
justifications.evidence: The two gate logs corroborate the manifest exactly - base-gate.log ends '161 passed, 1 warning in 134.67s' with EXIT=0 and head-gate.log '168 passed, 1 warning in 139.37s' with EXIT=0 - and the anchor-delta.log rows I checked (neutral_power_of_divertor_due_to_recombination, neutron_source_rate_due_to_thermal_fusion, energy_flux_at_wall_due_to_recombination, current_density_due_to_anomalous_transport) match the fragment's table cell for cell, but the fragment's stated head revision disagrees with the log it cites and its reach claim is too narrow.
justifications.fit: The added names state the mechanism with no plan label, deliverable id, ticket reference or version suffix (dd_source_exists and member_has_dd_source at imas_codex/standard_names/families.py:480 and :498, tests/standard_names/test_anchor_needs_dd_source.py), and the fragment follows the repository's plan-keyed docs/evidence/fragments layout the brief assigns.
justifications.goal_fidelity: Both selectors named in the goal now test the flag (imas_codex/standard_names/families.py:560 and :704), and the landed definitions are the only mechanism added, so the change does what the goal states; the reader's absence default at families.py:514 leaves the guard inert on caller-supplied rows, which is the goal's reach rather than the goal's content and is carried as a finding.
justifications.reuse: Searching the repository by capability for an owner of 'does a StandardName have a live dd producing source' found no single owner: source_invariant.py:46 counts ANY producer with a derived-parent exemption (the opposite answer for exactly the rows in question), and export.py:681 has_dd_source_binding tests the IMASNode HAS_STANDARD_NAME edge rather than the StandardNameSource PRODUCED_NAME edge - the two nearest mechanisms answer different questions, so families.py:480 adds a fourth inline spelling of the dd-producer predicate but consolidates it behind one builder inside its own module.
justifications.scope_discipline: The diff at 3657e68da contains only imas_codex/standard_names/families.py, tests/standard_names/test_anchor_needs_dd_source.py and the evidence fragment, all three inside the manifest's declared write paths, and carries nothing the goal does not imply.
